theme: Mixed Dark Futuristic (Dark hero, alternating light/dark sections)

typography.rules: DO NOT use Inter or generic sans for headings. Use Cabinet Grotesk for its premium, architectural tech feel. Use Outfit for high legibility body copy.

scale.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-black leading-none

colors.rules: Alternating sections MUST flip the primary background and text colors. The hero section must be dark_bg (#050505). High-contrast UI with neon blue (#0066FF) and kinetic orange (#FF5500) used strictly as accents and CTAs. NO full-screen gradients. Use subtle grain/noise overlays to prevent flat digital looks.

visual_enhancers.3d_libraries: react-tsparticles for a subtle floating constellation/tech-node background in the Hero section to give a 3D/parallax feel without heavy WebGL overhead.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a fixed noise overlay div with pointer-events-none and opacity-5 across the entire application to give a premium, tactile 'film grain' feel.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px delicate inner stroke (border-white/10 on dark, border-black/5 on light) for sticky navs and floating cards. NEVER use pure transparency without a blur.

layouts.grids: Use 'Bento Grid' protocols for Services and Industries. Start with grid-cols-1 on mobile, md:grid-cols-4 or md:grid-cols-8. Leave intentional empty grid cells to create negative space. Do not perfectly fill every row.
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Sections should use py-24 or py-32. Elements within cards use p-8 or p-12.
layouts.borders: Expose the grid. Use border-collapse styles or 1px border-border/40 for a highly technical, structured 'architectural' look.

motion.hero_kinetic: Masked line-by-line reveal on mount using Framer Motion. Text wrapped in overflow-hidden spans, translating Y from 100% to 0%.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee for an 'Editorial Ribbon' of Industries or Tech Stack. Extremely slow, smooth drift, large gaps (gap-24), high typography focus.
motion.scroll_reveals: Framer Motion whileInView transitions. Slight Y-axis offset (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1) with staggered children for lists.
motion.interactions: Hover states should lift elements slightly (-translate-y-1) and enhance border glow or color. All buttons must have scale-down on tap (whileTap={{ scale: 0.95 }}).

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST use .js and .jsx files for React components. Do NOT use .tsx.
Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main App wrapper.
Use Framer Motion for scroll-reveals (whileInView) and kinetic typography.
Set up dynamic routing (react-router-dom) to navigate between Home, About, Services, Products, Industries, Tech, and Contact.
Install and use 'lucide-react' for all icons.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' and 'Outfit' are imported via Google Fonts or Fontsource in index.css.
NEVER use generic placeholder URLs for images. Use the provided high-quality image_urls.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button').
Header MUST NOT be fully transparent over content. Use glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 (for dark) or bg-white/70 (for light).
For the 'Subtle Parallax / 3D' hero requirement, utilize 'react-tsparticles' or a custom framer-motion parallax setup behind the main text.
Alternate sections between light theme (bg-[#FAFAFA] text-[#0A0A0A]) and dark theme (bg-[#050505] text-[#FFFFFF]) to create a rhythmic scrolling experience.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make creative, distinctive frontends.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients. Use dark solid colors.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and asymmetrical bento grids.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions to specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in CSS. Let natural HTML document flow control text alignment (mostly left-aligned).
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations & brand color relevance.
NEVER use AI assistant emojis 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
